svg.text: Why gradient descent crawls, overshoots or flies away, and how scaling rounds the bowl
Stable only for alpha < 2 / (sum x^2 / m) = 2 / 4.667 = 0.4286
alpha = 0.10 reaches within 1e-6 of the minimum cost in 12 steps
alpha = 0.40 is inside the limit but overshoots each time before settling
each run uses alpha = 1 / lambda_max; stops at 99.9% of the gap closed
steps shown are the first 12 of the path
